name: Loom
whatYouLose: Reliable browser capture across operating systems and hardware
Video transcoding, adaptive delivery, and global storage infrastructure
Instant sharing, commenting, transcription, and editing polish
prompt: Build a local-first screen recorder prototype for Chromium. Capture a selected screen or tab plus microphone using MediaRecorder, show a recording timer and input levels, allow pause/resume, then provide an in-browser trim preview and WebM download. Add an optional self-hosted upload endpoint with expiring share links, simple comments, and SQLite metadata. Be explicit about browser support, file size limits, and the lack of production-grade transcoding. Use accessible vanilla JavaScript and an Astro server shell.
notes: You can prompt your way to a recorder prototype. You cannot prompt away a media pipeline, native capture edge cases, and global video delivery.
